CustomField.formula: IF( ISBLANK(Start_Call_Time__c), "", TEXT( CASE( MOD(HOUR(TIMEVALUE(Start_Call_Time__c + (5.5/24))),12), 0, 12, MOD(HOUR(TIMEVALUE(Start_Call_Time__c + (5.5/24))),12) ) ) & ":" & RIGHT("0" & TEXT(MINUTE(TIMEVALUE(Start_Call_Time__c + (5.5/24)))),2) & " " & IF(HOUR(TIMEVALUE(Start_Call_Time__c + (5.5/24))) < 12, "am", "pm") )
CustomField.label: Start Call Time (Text)
